newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -BUNDS TO FIND GOOD SUPPORT AT 101.50,42.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -BUNDS TO FIND GOOD SUPPORT AT 101.50,42.

text.p: September Bund futures traded on LIFFE are still in the 101.50, 102.17 range and could start to move higher despite a weak start on Monday, technical analysts said.
"Bunds are still within the prior range with the 101.50 lows held intact," said Charles Diebel, senior fixed income analyst at Technical Data in London.
He said a 50 percent Fibonacci retracement of the June and July rally came in at 101.42 helping to make the 101.50 to 42 region solid support.
At 0713 GMT, September Bunds were at 101.80 up 0.05.
In the short term Diebel said Bunds were likely to remain rangebound.
"But whichever way it breaks we should see a decent follow through," he said.
"On the downside 100.93 is the 61.8 percent retracement target and on the upside the next decent resistance area is at 103.00.
Diebel said daily momentum studies were beginning to base out suggesting moves higher towards 102.00. But he said only over 102.17 would the outlook turn bullish.
David Wood, an independent technical analyst near London said Bunds had held up quite well.
"There's a lot more strength in Europe and it's trying to detach itself from the U.S. a bit more," he said.

Technical analysts at Chase in London said further short term gains for Bunds were likely but that price activity over 101.50 could be interpreted as a minor fourth wave correction in an Elliott wave pattern.
They said in a research note, gains might extend to levels above Thursday's high at 102.17 but Bunds could then head down.
To the downside if 101.46 was broken, sentiment would turn.
"The chart outlook weakens on a decline below 101.46 sugessting 101.13," they said.
At the short end, December Euromarks were at 96.53, up two basis points on the day.
